summary: All requirements (REQ-5 through REQ-11) have been implemented. The diff shows backend data model changes with payment status variants and notes field, frontend UI updates in LeadCard and LeadDetailDialog for display and editing, payment status filtering on LeadsPage, and export schema updates to include payment status and notes in CSV exports. Implementation appears complete with proper optional field handling and color coding.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module adds 'cancelled' payment status variant not specified in requirements
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-5 explicitly defines three payment status values: Pending, Paid, and Failed. The migration.mo file introduces a fourth variant '#cancelled' that was not requested.
